title: Double Integral over a Skewed Parallelogram
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate iint_R (x + y) dA where R is bounded by x + y = 0, x + y = 2, x - 2y = 0, and x - 2y = 3.

steps.title: Define New Coordinates u and v
steps.mathExpression: u = x + y, \quad v = x - 2y \implies 0 \le u \le 2, \; 0 \le v \le 3
steps.explanation: The transformation maps the skewed region R into a simple rectangle [0, 2] x [0, 3] in uv.

steps.title: Compute Inverse Jacobian
steps.explanation: Invert the Jacobian determinant of the direct mapping.

steps.title: Evaluate Transformed Integral
steps.mathExpression: \iint_R (x + y) \, dA = \int_0^2 \int_0^3 u \left( \frac{1}{3} \right) dv \, du = \left( \frac{1}{3} \right) (3) \int_0^2 u \, du = \left[ \frac{u^2}{2} \right]_0^2 = 2
steps.explanation: Evaluate the product of separated single integrals.
